market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and risk-off. Oil at $100 and bond selloff create headwinds. Dow below key level signals further downside. Yen intervention adds FX noise. AI names may pull back 10-15% before resuming. 1-3 months: expect 5-8% equity volatility with energy outperforming.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but uneven. AI capex cycle and EM recovery (China, Vietnam, Korea) support 6-12 month upside. However, persistent inflation from oil and trade wars may delay rate cuts. Favor quality, AI infrastructure, and EM over US cyclicals. 6-12 months: selective 8-12% equity gains in tech/EM.

Dow technical recovery above key level
